text:
Eli: morning all 44b first day, trying to land my onboarding PR but CI is unhappy. Buildkite fails with a pipeline access error and GH Actions complains about missing secrets. who should I bug?

Nora: welcome Eli! can you paste the Buildkite error? usually it's the GitHub app or team membership.

Eli: Buildkite output: 
error: install_buildkite_github_app: repository access denied (403)

Eli: GH Actions: 
Secrets are not available to this workflow.

ci-bot: Note: Organization setting "Allow actions and reusable workflows from" is set to "Only selected repositories".

Nora: two things then: 1) Buildkite GitHub App needs repo access (org owner or app admin to add). 2) GH Actions secrets access blocked by org policy or environment protection. Are you opening the PR from a fork?

Eli: branch is in-repo on github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples.

Ravi: if it's in-repo secrets should be available unless the environment requires reviewers. also check if the workflow uses self-hosted runners with specific labels; that can make jobs stuck.

Nora: i'll request Buildkite app access and add you to the infra-ci team; give it a minute to propagate. Eli, can you try re-running the workflow after I approve it on the PR?

Eli: doing that now.

ci-bot: Buildkite pipeline access granted for sdk-examples (install completed).

Eli: GH Action rerun still shows secret missing. I see the job targets environment "staging-tests" which has required reviewers.

Nora: yep that's it. either remove the env protection for the onboarding branch or ask a maintainer to approve the deployment so the job gets the secret.

Ravi: FYI common gotcha: if the workflow is triggered by a PR from a fork we never expose org secrets. For new hires we ask people to branch in-repo until they've been added to infra-ci.

Eli: maintainer approved the env, re-run succeeded and Buildkite passed too. thanks! any docs on these CI gotchas?

Nora: docs/onboarding/ci.md covers the main issues (app install, runner labels, env protections). i'll DM you the link and we can do a quick walkthrough later. welcome aboard :party_parrot:
